notes: Complete ordinary-C reconstruction of a 0xffff-terminated list of five-halfword commands. Each record supplies the leading source value, three signed geometry values converted to u16 for Func_08010424, and a signed delay converted to u16 for Func_080030f8.

The retained assembly establishes the 10-byte stride, signed payload loads, conversion order, six-argument Func_08010424 call, delay call, and terminator. The packed two-byte-aligned record expresses that observed wire layout without inventing padding.
The exact SpawnBattleEffectObjects sibling was used only as a source-shape example for a compact command-record loop; it is not evidence for this owner's field meanings or types.

The first complete draft compiled to 88 bytes and exposed two linked discrepancies: an ABI-padded 12-byte record stride and premature optimization of the signed payload conversions. One targeted correction fixed the record layout and materialized all four signed payload loads before their u16 call-boundary conversions.

After that one correction, canonical GCC 2.96 emits 92 bytes against 116 reference bytes, with equal control-flow topology, 56 differing halfwords, and 60 wrong instructions. The remaining difference is chiefly register allocation and load materialization: the reference preserves all four signed loads and advances separate record/head pointers, while the compiler folds two loads to ldrh and uses one pointer.
This measured draft claims zero DONE bytes. Retained assembly remains authoritative; no fixed-register variable, inline assembly, frame forcing, or assembly classification is used.
